newsitem.title: CANADA: Hudson's Bay sees C$220 mln in capex.
newsitem.headline: Hudson's Bay sees C$220 mln in capex.

text.p: Hudson's Bay Co said on Thursday that it planned to invest C$220 million in capital expenditures this year.
Canada's oldest retailer said it planned to open 10 Zellers stores in 1997 and renovate 60 others to increase total floor space by one million square feet.

It said Zellers, a discount chain, would convert some of its administrative space to sales and add features such as pharmacies, photofinishing, lottery booths, restaurants, portrait studios, beauty salons, optical departments and home improvements.
Hudson Bay said it would also "dramatically" expand two of its Bay stores in 1997 and complete major renovations at 14 other stores.
The company said it would also spend C$25 million on new or replacement technology.
The Bay has 101 stores in Canada and Zellers has 296 locations across Canada.
